title: Fix the Missing Semicolon
description: The program should declare a variable and print it.
actualProblem: The statement int total = 10 + 5 is missing its terminating semicolon, so the compiler reports a syntax error ';' expected.
explanation: Java requires every statement to end with a semicolon. Without it, the compiler cannot tell where one statement ends and the next begins, and reports a parse error.
